title: 風機變流器與電氣保護
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討背對背變流器、直流匯流排與故障穿越的能量協調，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore energy coordination of back-to-back converters, DC links and fault ride-through, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。穿越曲線、無功優先與跳脫時限須取自實際併網規範；本課不提供現場保護設定。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Ride-through curves, reactive-current priority and trip delays come from the actual grid code; this course does not prescribe field protection settings.

stages.title: 拓樸與座標
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成拓樸與座標；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete topology and frames through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 比較 DFIG 與全功率拓樸：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Compare DFIG and full converters: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解比較 DFIG 與全功率拓樸，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand compare dfig and full converters through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 以 0.2 滑差作量級比較，並指出轉子暫態電流不能僅用平均滑差估算。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Use slip 0.2 for an order-of-magnitude comparison and flag rotor transient current as a separate constraint. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 以 0.2 滑差作量級比較，並指出轉子暫態電流不能僅用平均滑差估算。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Use slip 0.2 for an order-of-magnitude comparison and flag rotor transient current as a separate constraint. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「比較 DFIG 與全功率拓樸」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把背對背變流器、直流匯流排與故障穿越的能量協調的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If compare dfig and full converters disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of energy coordination of back-to-back converters, DC links and fault ride-through behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「比較 DFIG 與全功率拓樸」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for compare dfig and full converters, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 比較 DFIG 與全功率拓樸：原理
knowledge.titleEn: Compare DFIG and full converters: principle
knowledge.text: 雙饋機轉子變流器處理滑差功率；全功率機將全部電功率經變流器。
knowledge.textEn: A DFIG rotor converter processes slip power; a full converter processes all electrical power.

knowledge.title: 比較 DFIG 與全功率拓樸：證據
knowledge.titleEn: Compare DFIG and full converters: evidence
knowledge.text: 以 0.2 滑差作量級比較，並指出轉子暫態電流不能僅用平均滑差估算。
knowledge.textEn: Use slip 0.2 for an order-of-magnitude comparison and flag rotor transient current as a separate constraint.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：C=20 mF 的直流電容從 1,000 V 升至 1,100 V，ΔE=C(V₂²−V₁²)/2=2.10 kJ。若機側比網側多輸入 100 kW，只需約 21 ms 累積這份能量，忽略損耗。 穿越曲線、無功優先與跳脫時限須取自實際併網規範；本課不提供現場保護設定。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 20 mF DC capacitor rising from 1,000 to 1,100 V stores ΔE=C(V₂²−V₁²)/2=2.10 kJ. A 100 kW machine-to-grid power imbalance accumulates this in about 21 ms, neglecting losses. Ride-through curves, reactive-current priority and trip delays come from the actual grid code; this course does not prescribe field protection settings.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「風機變流器與電氣保護」的「比較 DFIG 與全功率拓樸：建立模型」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源來源、導體、負載、回流與保護的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「微電網：守住晚高峰」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓模型的接線圖、電流方向、測點與時間戳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Compare DFIG and full converters: build the model” in “Wind-turbine converters and electrical protection”. Draw the source, conductor, load, return and protection boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Microgrid: Protect the Evening Reserve” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for isolated low-voltage wiring diagram, current direction, measurement points and timestamps, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.
